envelope.error_digest: sha256:<64 lowercase hexadecimal>; digest of the canonical public envelope with error_digest omitted

unknown_internal_rule: Any unmapped or unexpectedly thrown implementation condition projects as GKOS_P6_INTERNAL_ERROR. Declared malformed request and input classes use the exact projections below. Native message, type, code, path, or stack may never pass through.
authentication_oracle_rule: Malformed, unknown, mismatched, disabled-agent, and revoked-credential presentations all project as GKOS_P6_AUTH_FAILED at an unauthenticated boundary. Owner-authenticated inspection may return the distinct lifecycle codes below.

projection.cli: Write exactly one canonical envelope plus LF to stderr and use cli_exit. Secret-bearing stdout is empty.
projection.http_pre_jsonrpc: Apply this exact first-failure precedence before JSON-RPC dispatch: (1) non-loopback or invalid peer GKOS_P6_PEER_FORBIDDEN/403; (2) invalid Host GKOS_P6_HOST_FORBIDDEN/403; (3) invalid Origin GKOS_P6_ORIGIN_FORBIDDEN/403; (4) method normalization, accepting only exact uppercase POST or DELETE and mapping every other category to GKOS_P6_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED/405 with Allow: POST, DELETE; (5) POST media validation or DELETE body/framing/Content-Type validation; (6) presented malformed/unsupported MCP-Protocol-Version, or missing version on a request that presents MCP-Session-Id; (7) unacceptable Accept; (8) session validation; (9) credential authentication. Stage 5 maps POST missing, malformed or unsupported Content-Type to GKOS_P6_UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE/415 and maps DELETE with nonempty body, Transfer-Encoding, noncanonical Content-Length, or any Content-Type to GKOS_P6_DELETE_INVALID/400. Use exactly the canonical envelope as response JSON with request_id null for every failure at stages (1)-(9), even when bounded parsing or authentication has internally allocated an identifier; that identifier is never projected at this boundary. No lower-precedence check runs after a failure.
projection.http_peer: Use only the accepted socket peer address, never Forwarded/X-Forwarded-For or proxy metadata. It must be the exact binary IPv4 127.0.0.1 or IPv6 ::1 address matching a physically loopback-bound listener; absent, unparsable, IPv4-mapped, zone-qualified, proxy-reported or any other address is GKOS_P6_PEER_FORBIDDEN/403.
projection.http_host: Host must be exactly the bound listener authority 127.0.0.1:<actual-port> or [::1]:<actual-port> in canonical ASCII with one matching port; localhost, omitted port, userinfo, whitespace, trailing dot, alternate IP spelling, zone ID, comma/list, duplicate Host, or any other authority is GKOS_P6_HOST_FORBIDDEN/403.
projection.http_origin: Origin may be absent for non-browser clients. If present it must be exactly http://127.0.0.1:<actual-port> or http://[::1]:<actual-port> matching the accepted listener, with no credentials, path other than empty, query, fragment, opaque/null/multiple value, alternate spelling or HTTPS claim; otherwise GKOS_P6_ORIGIN_FORBIDDEN/403.
projection.jsonrpc_protocol: Parse failure is -32700; malformed JSON-RPC request is -32600; an otherwise valid request whose method is unknown is GKOS_P6_JSONRPC_METHOD_NOT_FOUND with HTTP 200 and JSON-RPC -32601; malformed CallToolRequest parameters and unknown tool name are -32602; unexpected server failure is -32603. When a request id exists, data is exactly the canonical envelope.
projection.mcp_tool_domain: A well-formed tools/call whose advertised tool-input schema validation or reached domain operation fails returns JSON-RPC success with CallToolResult.isError=true and structuredContent.error exactly equal to the envelope. The per-entry mcp_code is a compatibility class, not a second domain envelope.
projection.http_method: The controlled adapter normalizes every raw method into exactly POST, DELETE, OTHER_TOKEN, or INVALID_OR_UNAVAILABLE. POST and DELETE require exact uppercase ASCII and advance. Every recognized standard method other than POST/DELETE, every syntactically valid extension token, lowercase/mixed-case spelling, empty/over-32-byte/control/non-ASCII/whitespace/malformed method, or parser-unavailable method metadata coalesces to GKOS_P6_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED/405 with Allow: POST, DELETE. No method spelling or category is disclosed.
projection.http_content_type: After peer/Host/Origin/method pass, stage 5 branches only by the accepted method. POST accepts Content-Type only as application/json with optional syntactically valid parameters; missing, malformed or unsupported values coalesce to GKOS_P6_UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE/415. DELETE accepts only a zero-byte body with Transfer-Encoding absent, Content-Length absent or exactly one canonical decimal 0, and Content-Type absent; nonempty/chunked/ambiguous body framing, any Content-Type including application/json, or any combination coalesces to GKOS_P6_DELETE_INVALID/400. Group members disclose no media/body distinction and use the canonical envelope.
projection.http_protocol_version: After Content-Type passes, any presented MCP-Protocol-Version must be exactly 2025-11-25. A request presenting MCP-Session-Id must also present that version. Absence is permitted only for a session-establishing initialize request with no session header; after bounded JSON-RPC parse, any other no-session request is MCP_NOT_INITIALIZED/GKOS_P6_INVALID_REQUEST. Missing-with-session, malformed and unsupported version values coalesce to GKOS_P6_PROTOCOL_VERSION_INVALID/400 without a supported-version oracle.
projection.http_accept: After protocol-version validation, a Streamable HTTP POST that does not advertise both application/json and text/event-stream returns GKOS_P6_NOT_ACCEPTABLE, HTTP 406, and the canonical envelope before dispatch.
projection.http_session: A presented unknown, expired, closed, or terminated MCP-Session-Id returns GKOS_P6_SESSION_UNKNOWN, HTTP 404, and the same content-free envelope. A required but missing session header returns GKOS_P6_INVALID_REQUEST and HTTP 400. Credential authentication failure remains GKOS_P6_AUTH_FAILED and HTTP 401. Every stage-8 session and stage-9 authentication rejection has request_id null; no server-assigned or caller-derived identifier is projected.
projection.mcp_notification: Send no JSON-RPC response. An accepted Streamable HTTP notification returns HTTP 202 with an empty body.
projection.cancellation: notifications/cancelled receives no response; a cancellation that wins is recorded only in content-free authority activity.
